StringTie 3.0.3: stringtie (assembly, -e estimation, --merge)
Licence: MIT (LICENSE in this folder). Contains the HTSlib, htscodecs, libdeflate, bzip2 and XZ that StringTie
bundles, and zlib 1.3.1: their notices are LICENSE.* and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt; the loader is
Emscripten's runtime (MIT and NCSA: LICENSE.emscripten).
Upstream source: https://github.com/gpertea/stringtie/releases/tag/v3.0.3 (stringtie-3.0.3.offline.tar.gz)

Compiled to WebAssembly by the genomics-wasm project (https://github.com/comparativechrono/genomics-wasm,
commit e8c3e15): Emscripten 3.1.64, StringTie's own option for a build without threads (NOTHREADS).
Everything needed to build it again is described in ../../../licenses/genomics-wasm-build/.

Changes to the source (tools/stringtie/browser.patch there): two locks for the coverage output that the
build without threads left unguarded, and -p N (N > 1) is refused. Transcript assembly and estimation are
unchanged. The loader (stringtie.js) was linked for the program runner of this site and records the exit
status.

In the workbench's terminal, stringtie -p N (N > 1) is left out with a note.

Checked against StringTie 3.0.3 built natively from the same source (genomics-wasm's comparison: 27 of 27
cases with human and yeast RNA-seq alignments; and in the workbench with the example data): the same GTF
records and gene abundance table (apart from the command line in the GTF header).
